product.ta-80.summary: The TA 80 combined database queries and printing in a desktop terminal.
product.ta-80.history: Triumph-Adler offered it for accessing information on a central computer. The screen and fast printer shared the same enclosure, with a separate keyboard.
product.ta-80.technical.configuration: The magnetic reader identified users. The manual places the reader at the side and the rotary printer at the front.
product.ta-80.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-80.technical.limitations: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
